slug: 我反派魔尊开局被清冷师尊强吻
content_zh:
【本文不仅有疯狂宠徒的清冷师尊，还有疯狂冲师的病娇逆徒，是本日常风的纯甜狗粮文！】
“我不就熬夜玩黄油吗？这给我干哪来了！”
江尘羽望着眼前的殿堂，以及自己身上披着的赤金色道袍，开始怀疑起了人生。
这个殿堂他再熟悉不过了。
在扮演黄油主角的时候，他不止一次将与他同名的反派魔尊绞杀这个房间里。
之后还会和女主展开激烈的捉对厮杀，最终打出人民群众喜闻乐见的战败cg。
至于这身道袍，他也非常熟悉，毕竟在穿上这件道袍后，将会更加容易刷取魔尊江尘羽的三位女徒弟的好感度。
并且在穿着这件衣服专心与魔尊的女徒弟们一起修炼时，也能够解锁更多的武学姿势。
“完蛋了，天崩开局，居然成为黄油死得最惨的魔头反派了！”
江尘羽站在一面流转着银白色闪光的华丽镜子前，苦涩地笑了下。
《爱恋江湖》中有大大小小的几百条主线以及支线，其中各种各样好的坏的结局也有将近百种。
但不管是其中的哪一种，反派魔头江尘羽都没有活下来过！
一次都没有！
最好的结局，也是在与正道魁首之一的美女师尊分离后凭借惊人意志抗过天魔之体的侵蚀，在小地方苟着当魔头。
但是，就算是苟起来，狗编剧们也还是没有放过江尘羽。
在十几二十年后，修为通天的魔头江尘羽最终被主角与女主生的两三个娃喊着“羁绊啊，友情啊”之类的话后爆种当精英怪刷掉了。
“算了，既来之则安之，虽然风险确实是高了点，但是回报也不低嘛！”
“好歹起点很高！”
江尘羽看着镜子中一袭黑发，眼眸深邃，五官英俊的男子，随后长长地出了一口气。
这么多结局里边。

他江尘羽被剑捅死过，被腰斩过，以各种各样的方法被绞杀过，但是就是没有掉逼格过！
也是因此，虽然他化身大爱魔尊干了不知道多少畜牲的事。
甚至不止一次将人气女主给一把抓住并且顷刻炼化，也还是拥有极高的人气。
甚至有万人血书，希望以江尘羽的视角出一个新的支线，并将魔头的师尊玉曦道人变成可攻略的女主！
在《爱恋江湖》这么多好看的女角色里头，就只有谢曦雪无法被主角给攻略。
因为除了有一条魔尊苟活的故事线以外，这位正道领袖之一都坚定不移的站在反派魔头的身边。
在主角即将击败自己前，也会自我了断，搞得玩家们是心头痒痒的。
在得不到的永远在骚动这一念头的影响下，仿若冰山雪莲般只可远观不可亵玩的谢曦雪也一直占据女角人气榜的第一。
“现在稍微整理一下情报吧！”
“首先，美女师尊是队友，这点是毋庸置疑的。
虽然哪怕有她的保护，江魔头也没有活过一次，但该抱的大腿肯定还是得抱。”
“除此之外，我还得将我那三位女徒弟的好感度给刷上来。
毕竟，她们仨的天资都非常恐怖！
大徒弟拥有剑仙赐福，二徒弟则拥有凤凰血脉，至于三徒弟更是拥有先天道体，被魔头严选的血液炉鼎。”
“这位仨徒弟因为魔头的缘故，每一位都过得挺惨的。
不过要选一位最惨的，还得是三徒弟那丫头。
她从小就被大魔头当做压抑天魔之体的道具关在地下室里养着，甚至连外出晒太阳都只是一种奢望！”

[This article not only contains the cold master who crazily dotes on his disciples, but also the sick and rebellious disciple who crazily attacks the master. It is a pure sweet dog food article in the daily style! 】
"Why don't I just stay up late and play with butter? Where did this come from!"
Jiang Chenyu looked at the palace in front of him and the red-gold Taoist robe on his body, and began to doubt his life.
He knew this palace very well.
While playing the protagonist of Butter, he strangled his eponymous villain Demon Lord in this room more than once.
After that, he will have a fierce fight with the heroine, and finally create a defeating cg that the people love to see.
As for this Taoist robe, he is also very familiar with it. After all, after wearing this Taoist robe, it will be easier to win the favor of the three female disciples of Demon Lord Jiang Chenyu.
And when wearing this piece of clothing and focusing on practicing with the Demon King's female disciples, you can also unlock more martial arts postures.
"It's over. In the beginning of Tianbeng, he actually became the villain who died the most miserably in Butter!"
Jiang Chenyu stood in front of a gorgeous mirror with silvery white glitter and smiled bitterly.
There are hundreds of main lines and branch lines in "Love Jianghu", and there are nearly a hundred kinds of good and bad endings.
But no matter which one it is, the villain Jiang Chenyu has never survived!
Not even once!
The best ending is that after being separated from the beautiful master, one of the leaders of the righteous path, he relied on his amazing will to resist the erosion of the devil's body, and managed to remain a devil in a small place.
However, even if he kept quiet, the dog writers still didn't let Jiang Chenyu go.
More than ten or twenty years later, the demon Jiang Chenyu, who was extremely skilled in the world, was finally wiped out by the two or three children of the protagonist and the heroine, who shouted "bonds, friendships" and other words, and then became elite monsters.
"Forget it, take it easy when you get it. Although the risk is indeed a bit high, the reward is not low either!"
"At least the starting point is very high!"
Jiang Chenyu looked at the man with black hair, deep eyes and handsome features in the mirror, and then let out a long breath.
There are so many endings.
He, Jiang Chenyu, had been stabbed to death with a sword, chopped in half, and strangled in various ways, but he had never failed!
It was also because of this that although he transformed into the Great Love Demon Lord and did countless beastly things.
Even the popular heroine was caught and instantly refined more than once, and she still has extremely high popularity.
There are even thousands of blood letters, hoping to create a new branch line from Jiang Chenyu's perspective and turn the devil's master, Taoist Yu Xi, into a conquerable heroine!
Among the many good-looking female characters in "Love in the World", only Xie Xixue cannot be captured by the protagonist.
Because except for a story line in which the demon king survives, this leader of the right path has always stood firmly by the side of the villain demon king.
The protagonist will also kill himself before defeating him, which makes the players feel itchy.
Under the influence of the idea that what is not available will always be in turmoil, Xie Xixue, who can only be viewed from a distance but not played with like an iceberg and a snow lotus, has always occupied the first place in the popularity list of female characters.
"Now let's sort out the information a little bit!"
"First of all, the beautiful master is a teammate, there is no doubt about this.
Although Demon Jiang never survived even with her protection, he still had to hug the thighs that should be hugged. "
"In addition, I also have to improve the favorability of my three female apprentices.
After all, the three of them have terrifying talents!
The eldest apprentice has the blessing of the Sword Immortal, the second apprentice has the bloodline of the Phoenix, and the third apprentice has an innate Taoist body and is a blood cauldron carefully selected by the devil. "
"Because of the devil, each of these three disciples has had a miserable life.
But if I had to choose the one who suffered the most, it would have to be the girl from the third apprentice.
She has been kept in the basement by the big devil as a prop to suppress the devil's body since she was a child. Even going out to bask in the sun is just a luxury! "
